#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an ICS calendar entry for the Project Kickoff Meeting
on next Monday at 10:00 AM local time, lasting 2 hours."""

from datetime import date, datetime, time, timedelta, timezone

try:
    from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
    HAS_ZONEINFO = True
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    HAS_ZONEINFO = False

# --- Determine local timezone (as a valid ICS TZID) ---
now_local = datetime.now().astimezone()
tzinfo = now_local.tzinfo
tzid = None

if HAS_ZONEINFO and isinstance(tzinfo, ZoneInfo):
    tzid = str(tzinfo)  # IANA name, e.g. 'America/New_York'
elif isinstance(tzinfo, timezone):
    if tzinfo is timezone.utc or tzinfo.utcoffset(None) == timedelta(0):
        tzid = "UTC"

use_utc = tzid is None  # fall back to UTC times if no named TZID is available
if use_utc:
    tzid = "UTC"

# --- Compute next Monday (strictly after today) ---
today = date.today()
days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7
kickoff_date = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

# --- Build start/end datetimes ---
if use_utc or tzid == "UTC":
    local_start = datetime(kickoff_date.year, kickoff_date.month, kickoff_date.day,
                           10, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
else:
    local_start = datetime(kickoff_date.year, kickoff_date.month, kickoff_date.day,
                           10, 0, tzinfo=tzinfo)
local_end = local_start + timedelta(hours=2)
stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

def fmt_local(dt):
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")

uid = "project-kickoff-%s@calendar-skill" % stamp.strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f")

lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    "UID:" + uid,
    "DTSTAMP:" + stamp.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ"),
]

if use_utc or tzid == "UTC":
    lines.append("DTSTART:" + fmt_local(local_start) + "Z")
    lines.append("DTEND:" + fmt_local(local_end) + "Z")
else:
    lines.append("DTSTART;TZID=%s:%s" % (tzid, fmt_local(local_start)))
    lines.append("DTEND;TZID=%s:%s" % (tzid, fmt_local(local_end)))

lines.extend([
    "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
])

content = "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"

out_path = "project_kickoff.ics"
with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(content)

# --- Validate the written file ---
with open(out_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    raw = f.read()
assert raw.startswith("BEGIN:VCALENDAR")
assert "END:VCALENDAR" in raw
assert "BEGIN:VEVENT" in raw and "END:VEVENT" in raw
assert "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting" in raw
assert "DTSTART" in raw and "DTEND" in raw

print("Wrote:", out_path)
print("Meeting date:", kickoff_date.strftime("%A, %Y-%m-%d"))
print("Start:", local_start.isoformat())
print("End:", local_end.isoformat())
print("Timezone (TZID):", tzid)
print("UID:", uid)
print("Validation: OK")
